audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0,1,4,5,6].side all read 'Skill' while content win[] and the packet levelChart already read Blitzcrank/Blitzcrank/Skill/Skill/Maokai/Blitzcrank/Maokai — five of seven rows disagreed between the two layers.
audit.why: Rocket Grab is an instant level-1/2 pick threat (content whys[0-1]), Nature's Grasp and 2+ item tankiness already favor Maokai (phases[4].why and phases[6].why already read that way), and a fed Q-E-R combo swings first item back to Blitzcrank (content whys[5]).
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0,1,5].side to 'Blitzcrank' with matching why text; moved phases[4,6].side to 'Maokai' (why text there already described the Maokai-favoring verdict, so only the side flag needed to change). win[] needed no edits — it already held the correct values throughout.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flagged three unmentioned interactions: mutual knockup race (Bramble Smash/Sapling Toss vs Power Fist), Blitzcrank's Mana Barrier/Static Field shield absorbing burst, and Power Fist's auto-attack-reset wind-up as the real all-in tell.
audit.why: Whoever lands their displacement first controls the trade; his shield changes all-in math; and the E wind-up (not the ability cast) is the actual cue to disengage.
audit.corrected: Folded the knockup race and shield-absorb into breakdown.trading's good/bad trade clauses; folded the auto-reset tell into dontsFull[2].d, replacing its copy-pasted tradeBad text.

edits.before: - Blitzcrank Rocket Grab: matchup-defining — The hook IS the champion — minion cover turns the lane into a farming sim. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep Q Bramble Smash banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Rocket Grab is 20/19/18/17/16s — minion cover turns the lane into a farming sim while it's down. The duo's tempo bends around it. - Keep Bramble Smash (7-5s) banked for their best play. - Static Field's silence (60/40/20s) is a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: Good trade: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all. Bad trade: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Good trade: land your knockup (Q or E) before his Power Fist lands — whoever displaces first owns the trade. Bad trade: all-in before Mana Barrier's shield or Static Field burns off — it absorbs your whole burst window.
